## Mentorship Programs

### North America

| Program Name | Deadline | Comment |
|-------------|----------|---------|
| [ASU Summer Research Initiative (SURI)](https://students.engineering.asu.edu/graduate/research/suri/) | February 02, 2026 | Open to global applicants; 8-week summer research program; $5,000 stipend and on-campus housing |
| CMU LTI - Language Technology for All Summer Internship [Link](https://forms.gle/cUu8g6wb27HsWWkd7) | February 20, 2026 | In-person research internship at Carnegie Mellon for pre-doctoral students interested in language technology; 12–14 weeks; travel covered plus stipend for housing and expenses |
| [Fatima Fellowship](https://fatima.institute/) | Nov-Dec (every year) | Open to global applicants; 9-month program remotely (online); for aspiring researchers in computer science |

### Europe

| Program Name | Deadline | Comment |
|-------------|----------|---------|
| [Aalto Science Institute International Summer Research Programme](https://www.aalto.fi/en/aalto-science-institute-asci/aalto-science-institute-international-summer-research-programme) | January 31, 2026 | Open to bachelor's and master's students worldwide; 12-week paid summer research program in Finland |
| [DAAD RISE Germany](https://www.daad.de/rise/en/rise-germany/) | Oct 15 – Nov 30 (annually) | Summer research at German universities; English widely accepted; CS projects available |

### Asia

| Program Name | Deadline | Comment |
|-------------|----------|---------|
| [KAUST Visiting Student Research Program (VSRP)](https://vsrp.kaust.edu.sa/) | Rolling | 3–6 month research program in Saudi Arabia; includes stipend, housing, airfare, and health insurance |
| [OIST Research Internship Program](https://admissions.oist.jp/oist-research-internship-program-description) | October / April (two cycles yearly) | 2–6 month research program in Japan; includes stipend, housing, and travel support |
